project.name: bot-pilot-google-calendar-connector-infrastructure-persistence
project.description:
Driven adapter: JPA + Spring Data persistence for Google Calendar credentials.
Implements the CredentialRepository port (from calendar-spi) using Spring Data JPA backed by MySQL. The adapter translates between the GoogleCalendarCredentials JPA entity (domain module) and the CredentialRepository contract (spi module).
Schema: table google_credentials — columns match the Python SQLAlchemy model exactly. ddl-auto: validate (schema is pre-created, never managed by Hibernate).
Why MySQL and not H2/Postgres? The Python service used MySQL. Keeping the same RDBMS avoids a schema migration and ensures the Vault role (bot-connectors-calendar-role) continues to work without changes to the Vault database secrets engine configuration.
